'''Nobuhiko Okamoto''' (Japanese: '''岡本信彦''' ''Okamoto Nobuhiko'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.  

==Biography==
Okamoto was born on October 24, 1986 in {{wp|Tokyo|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. Okamoto started out his work as {{ga|Brendan}} for the [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Animated Trailer|animated trailer]] of [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire]]. His most prominent role in {{aniseries|PTS}} was {{Ash}}'s [[rival]], {{an|Gladion}}, which he played during {{aniseries|SM}}. Okamoto is currently affiliated with {{wp|Pro-Fit}}. He won both the Best Rookie Actor Award and Best Supporting Actor Award during the {{wp|3rd Seiyu Awards}} of 2009 and the {{wp|5th Seiyu Awards}} of 2011, respectively.
